summary: What the init() badge firmware saved on a board (its profile record and settings), the battery, and the panel's brightness.

sources.name: badgeProfile
sources.summary: The saved badge: name, company, the social link and its label, and "app:/data/avatar" when there is a photo.

sources.name: badgeSettings
sources.summary: The saved settings: brightness 10-100, orientation "Free", "Default", or "180", and the invitation unlock.

sources.name: badgeBattery
sources.summary: The battery in percent, or -1 when the board cannot read it.

ops.name: panel
ops.summary: Answers {"brightness": n}: the brightness the app last set, or -1.
